lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑翔，比跑步快。
lines.en: I skim the ground, faster than running.
A blue shadow streaks over the hills.

lines.zh: 我飘着走，脚几乎不沾土。
lines.en: I drift along, feet barely touching soil.

lines.zh: 四万战斗力，全在这双腿上。
lines.en: Forty thousand in power, all in these legs.

lines.zh: 我在半空打了个转，继续往前。
lines.en: I bank in midair and keep going.

lines.zh: 基纽部队就我一个这么快。
lines.en: I'm the only one on the squad this fast.
I loop around on purpose to tease you.

lines.zh: 这速度，连我自己都笑了。
lines.en: At this speed even I have to laugh.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下去，又猛地拉起。
lines.en: I dive low, then snap back up.

lines.zh: 风在我耳边拉成一条线。
lines.en: The wind stretches into a line past my ear.

lines.zh: 我绕着你跑圈，只是想看看。
lines.en: I circle you, just to have a look.
The ones on the ground are far too slow.
Arms folded, I hover in the air.

lines.zh: 站着不动的时候，我数云。
lines.en: When I hold still, I count clouds.

lines.zh: 肌肉绷着，随时能冲出去。
lines.en: My muscles stay coiled, ready to launch.

lines.zh: 我歪头打量自己的手套。
lines.en: I tilt my head at my own glove.
Quiet? I don't care for quiet.

lines.zh: 我哼着曲子，脚在空中晃。
lines.en: I hum, feet swinging in the air.

lines.zh: 这地方没什么能让我兴奋。
lines.en: Nothing here gets me excited.

lines.zh: 我拉伸了一下背，骨头咔响。
lines.en: I stretch my back; it pops.
Wait long enough and someone always comes to fight.
Breathing steady, I gather my ki.

lines.zh: 我对着空气比划了两下。
lines.en: I throw a couple of jabs at empty air.

lines.zh: 我脚尖悬着，随时能弹出去。
lines.en: My toes hover above the ground, ready to launch.
I squint at movement far off.
Still as I am, this is when I'm loosest.
You? You don't look fast.

lines.zh: 站着别动，我绕一圈看看。
lines.en: Stand still; I'll circle once and look.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，像看块石头。
lines.en: I look down at you like a stone.
Care to race me?
Your ki isn't weak, but it's not enough.

lines.zh: 我挑眉毛，觉得有点意思。
lines.en: I raise an eyebrow; you're interesting.
Don't reason with me; I only respect speed.
Let's see how many seconds you last.
What's that in your hand? Useless.
I laugh, and it's loud.

lines.zh: 你站那儿的姿势，全是破绽。
lines.en: The way you stand is full of openings.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，看你更清楚了。
lines.en: I sink lower to see you better.
Your eyes are decent; you didn't flinch.
I'll count to three and you'll move.
Speed is a gift; you can't learn it.

lines.zh: 我先让你一招，够意思吧。
lines.en: I'll give you the first move. Generous, no?
Don't worry; I'm quick. It won't hurt long.

lines.zh: 你和我之间，差的是距离。
lines.en: Between you and me, the gap is distance.
You landed one? That's a surprise.
My arm's gone numb. Rare.
Hurts enough that I can't laugh.

lines.zh: 蓝色气焰一抖，我把这拳记住了。
lines.en: My blue aura flickers; that punch is noted.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，重新看你的动作。
lines.en: I step back half a pace and study you again.
Blood drips off my chin.
You're stronger than you look.
I roll my neck and recover.
That's embarrassing.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，我收起了笑。
lines.en: After that hit, my grin is gone.
That little thing of yours? Beneath me.
Bribe me? Beat me in a race first.
Come closer; I can't be bothered to fly over.

lines.zh: 我闻到一股有意思的气。
lines.en: I catch an interesting ki signature.

lines.zh: 你要真有好东西，拿出来。
lines.en: If you've got something good, show it.

lines.zh: 我眼睛一亮，又装作不在意。
lines.en: My eyes light up, then I pretend they didn't.

lines.zh: 这东西，勉强值得我动一下。
lines.en: This barely earns a move from me.

lines.zh: 我滑过去一点点，就一点。
lines.en: I drift over a little. Just a little.

lines.zh: 别以为我贪，我好奇而已。
lines.en: Don't think I'm greedy; I'm merely curious.
Give it to me and I won't hit you.
Hit me? You can't even reach the edge.
One shift of my body and you're grasping air.
What you hit was an afterimage.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，你撞到的是空气。
lines.en: I turn aside and you hit nothing but air.
Your shoulder does land solidly.

lines.zh: 我抬脚一让，你摔了过去。
lines.en: I lift a foot aside and you stumble past.
You're panting after that; I'm fine.

lines.zh: 我的护肩蹭过你，算轻的。
lines.en: My shoulder guard grazes you; consider that gentle.
It's your slowness I mind, not your weight.
Back up; I'm about to launch.
I only stand beside the strong.

lines.zh: 你能追上我的影子再说。
lines.en: Catch my shadow first, then we'll talk.

lines.zh: 我这身材，队里没第二个。
lines.en: There's no second build like mine on the squad.
Not so fast; beat me once first.
I hate a teammate who drags.

lines.zh: 你要是够快，我请你喝酒。
lines.en: If you're fast enough, drinks are on me.

lines.zh: 并肩飞的时候，风最舒服。
lines.en: The wind is best when we fly side by side.

lines.zh: 我不说软话，你知道就好。
lines.en: I don't say soft things; you know how I feel.
I accept you because you didn't flinch.
Only two fast ones belong together.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿我顺手就拿了。
lines.en: I snatch this up in passing.

lines.zh: 弯腰太慢，我直接滑过去。
lines.en: Bending is slow; I slide right over.

lines.zh: 东西落地的声音，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard that hit the ground.

lines.zh: 小物件，我一根手指就夹住。
lines.en: A small thing — one finger is enough.
I weigh it; it's very light.

lines.zh: 掉下来的都归先到的人。
lines.en: Fallen loot goes to whoever gets there first.
I scoop it from the air, clean catch.

lines.zh: 这速度捡东西，谁也抢不过。
lines.en: Nobody outgrabs me at this speed.
I flick the dust off my hand.
Not bad. It's mine.
You moved — that's the start.
I've marked you. And blue is fast.

lines.zh: 别看我站着，我已经到了。
lines.en: I look still, but I'm already there.

lines.zh: 你的破绽在左边，我看见了。
lines.en: Your opening is on the left. I see it.

lines.zh: 我从上面来，你抬不起头。
lines.en: I come from above; you can't look up in time.
This fight will end quickly.
Your ki is wavering. Good.
I grin. Speed is the answer.

lines.zh: 跑吧，跑起来才有点意思。
lines.en: Run. It's only interesting if you run.

lines.zh: 基纽队里最快的，就是我。
lines.en: The fastest in the Ginyu Force — that's me.
The fastest of the Ginyu Force is me.
At this distance I arrive in an instant.
I move first, and you've already lost half a beat.

lines.zh: 地上那道影子，我一眼就认出来。
lines.en: That shadow on the ground, I pick it out at once.

lines.zh: 我盯上的是最快的那个。
lines.en: I go after the fastest one there is.
Right. You'll do.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，风都带着蓝。
lines.en: I circle you, and the wind turns blue.
Your left hand hasn't come up yet.

lines.zh: 我往上飞，你的视线追不上。
lines.en: I rise; your eyes can't keep up.
Don't turn — I've already moved.
One breath from you and I'm a meter closer.
I slow half a beat on purpose, just to play.
Behind? Ahead? Both wrong.
This loop of mine will make your eyes swim.

lines.zh: 你防得住一处，防不住两处。
lines.en: You can guard one side, not both.
I'm waiting for your ki to run out.

lines.zh: 这速度，你只看见一道蓝。
lines.en: At this speed you'll only see a streak of blue.

lines.zh: 别站原地，那样太快结束。
lines.en: Don't just stand there; that ends it too soon.
I'm cutting the distance to nothing.

lines.zh: 你后退的方向，我早猜到了。
lines.en: I already guessed which way you'd retreat.
A little faster and you might last.

lines.zh: 我这人打架爱笑，你别介意。
lines.en: I laugh when I fight; don't take it personally.
Almost — just this once more.
I pause half a second so you can see it coming.
A fist comes in from the side.

lines.zh: 我连打三下，你只挡了一下。
lines.en: Three strikes; you blocked one.
My elbow lands on your pauldron.
This kick carries my speed.
A midair spin, and my heel finds your back.
The blue hurricane is spinning up.
I hit and retreat; your swing finds nothing.

lines.zh: 速度加上力量，才叫打击。
lines.en: Speed plus strength — that's a real blow.
You gave half a step; here comes another.
My fist passes right by your ear.

lines.zh: 我专挑你抬手时的空档。
lines.en: I strike in the gap when you raise your arms.
Now your breathing's heavier.
Don't look up — I'm above.
Two hits in a row; you couldn't follow.
Doesn't hurt? Then I'll go faster.
I've driven you back three steps.

lines.zh: 我落到这片地上，扬起灰。
lines.en: I land here and kick up dust.
My blue ki arrives before I do.
I glide down from high above.

lines.zh: 这地方太空旷，正合我意。
lines.en: Nice and open here — suits me.
I straighten up, far taller than you.
The Ginyu Force has arrived.

lines.zh: 我一落地就看了看四周。
lines.en: I land and scan the area.
Someone's here; I can smell it.
I've stirred up the wind.
Not a bad entrance, was it?
A place like this comes apart in one punch.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，骨头响亮。
lines.en: I stretch, and my joints crack loudly.
My speed will come in handy here.

lines.zh: 我从云层里俯冲下来，落在草地上。
lines.en: I dive out of the clouds and land on the grass.
Stand up. I'm starting.
This trip won't be boring.
Let me see who's fastest around here.
The dust settles, and I'm still standing.
The flame only warms my skin.

lines.zh: 我撞进地面，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I slam into the ground, leaving a crater.

lines.zh: 水下飞不快，我讨厌这个。
lines.en: I can't fly fast underwater; I hate it.
The blast shoves me back a stretch.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的护腕，留下白痕。
lines.en: An arrow skims my bracer and leaves a white streak.
This force pins my movements.

lines.zh: 饿着的时候，速度也掉了。
lines.en: Empty stomach, and my speed drops too.

lines.zh: 雷电劈在我背上，蓝光更亮。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back; my blue flares brighter.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，我落得很慢。
lines.en: No wind in the void; I fall slowly.
